draft.text: You came in because you have pain in the back of your heel, especially after workouts or when you first get up in the morning.
You said the pain goes up into your calf and affects your training.
You don't have swelling, redness, or warmth in the area.
Your heel pain may be related to the increased intensity of your training for a triathlon.
You will need to monitor your pain and report any changes to your doctor.
Your doctor may suggest modifying your training routine.
